import numpy as np
from causallearn.graph.GeneralGraph import GeneralGraph
from causallearn.search.ScoreBased.GES import ges; from causallearn.utils.cit import CIT
def run_causal_discovery(X: np.ndarray) -> GeneralGraph:
    n, p = X.shape; G = ges(X, score_func="local_score_BDeu")['G']
    if p <= 20: return G
    cit = CIT(X, "gsq"); nds = G.get_nodes(); nm = {nds[k]: k for k in range(len(nds))}; cards = [len(np.unique(X[:, k])) for k in range(p)]
    for edge in list(G.get_graph_edges()):
        i, j = nm[edge.get_node1()], nm[edge.get_node2()]
        nbrs = sorted((set(nm[nb] for nb in G.get_adjacent_nodes(edge.get_node1())) | set(nm[nb] for nb in G.get_adjacent_nodes(edge.get_node2()))) - {i, j})
        tests = [[]] + [[k] for k in nbrs] + ([nbrs] if len(nbrs) > 1 else [])
        ok = [t for t in tests if cards[i]*cards[j]*int(np.prod([cards[k] for k in t]+[1])) <= n//5]
        if any(cit(i, j, t) > 0.01 for t in ok): G.remove_edge(edge)
    return G

import numpy as np
from causallearn.graph.GeneralGraph import GeneralGraph
from causallearn.graph.GraphNode import GraphNode

def run_causal_discovery(X: np.ndarray) -> GeneralGraph:
    import numpy as np
    import random
    from itertools import combinations
    from causallearn.graph.Edge import Edge
    from causallearn.graph.Endpoint import Endpoint
    from causallearn.score.LocalScoreFunctionClass import LocalScoreClass
    from causallearn.score.LocalScoreFunction import local_score_BDeu
    from causallearn.utils.DAG2CPDAG import dag2cpdag

    N = X.shape[1]
    
    MI_matrix = np.zeros((N, N))
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            if i >= j: continue
            bins_i = np.arange(int(np.max(X[:, i])) + 2)
            bins_j = np.arange(int(np.max(X[:, j])) + 2)
            p_ij, _, _ = np.histogram2d(X[:, i], X[:, j], bins=[bins_i, bins_j])
            p_ij = p_ij / p_ij.sum()
            nz = p_ij > 0
            p_i = np.sum(p_ij, axis=1, keepdims=True)
            p_j = np.sum(p_ij, axis=0, keepdims=True)
            denom = (p_i * p_j)[nz]
            mi = np.sum(p_ij[nz] * np.log(p_ij[nz] / denom))
            MI_matrix[i, j] = mi
            MI_matrix[j, i] = mi

    K = min(N - 1, 15)
    top_neighbors = []
    for i in range(N):
        idx = np.argsort(MI_matrix[i, :])[-K:]
        s = set(idx)
        s.discard(i)
        top_neighbors.append(s)

    score_func = LocalScoreClass(X, local_score_BDeu)
    subset_best_cache = [dict() for _ in range(N)]
    raw_score_cache = [dict() for _ in range(N)]
    
    def get_score(node, pa_list):
        pa_tuple = tuple(sorted(pa_list))
        if pa_tuple not in raw_score_cache[node]:
            raw_score_cache[node][pa_tuple] = score_func.score(node, list(pa_tuple))
        return raw_score_cache[node][pa_tuple]

    def get_best_score_and_parents(node, candidates_set):
        candidates_tuple = frozenset(candidates_set)
        if candidates_tuple in subset_best_cache[node]:
            return subset_best_cache[node][candidates_tuple]
        
        best_s = -float('inf')
        best_p = tuple()
        max_pa = min(len(candidates_tuple), 4)
        
        for k in range(max_pa + 1):
            for pa in combinations(candidates_tuple, k):
                s = get_score(node, list(pa))
                if s > best_s:
                    best_s = s
                    best_p = pa
                    
        subset_best_cache[node][candidates_tuple] = (best_s, best_p)
        return best_s, best_p

    def score_order(order):
        total_score = 0.0
        predecessors = set()
        for node in order:
            candidates = top_neighbors[node] & predecessors
            s, _ = get_best_score_and_parents(node, candidates)
            total_score += s
            predecessors.add(node)
        return total_score

    best_overall_score = -float('inf')
    best_overall_order = None
    NUM_RESTARTS = 6
    random.seed(42)
    
    for restart_idx in range(NUM_RESTARTS):
        current_order = list(range(N))
        random.shuffle(current_order)
            
        current_score = score_order(current_order)
        improved = True
        
        while improved:
            improved = False
            best_s = current_score
            best_o = None
            
            for i in range(N):
                for j in range(N):
                    if i == j: continue
                    new_order = current_order.copy()
                    node = new_order.pop(i)
                    new_order.insert(j, node)
                    
                    ns = score_order(new_order)
                    if ns > best_s:
                        best_s = ns
                        best_o = new_order
            
            if best_o is not None:
                current_score = best_s
                current_order = best_o
                improved = True
                
        if current_score > best_overall_score:
            best_overall_score = current_score
            best_overall_order = current_order
            
    dag_matrix = np.zeros((N, N), dtype=int)
    predecessors = set()
    for node in best_overall_order:
        candidates = top_neighbors[node] & predecessors
        _, best_p = get_best_score_and_parents(node, candidates)
        for p in best_p:
            dag_matrix[p, node] = 1
        predecessors.add(node)
        
    def has_path(start, end, adj):
        visited = set([start])
        stack = [start]
        while stack:
            curr = stack.pop()
            if curr == end: return True
            for child in range(N):
                if adj[curr, child] == 1 and child not in visited:
                    visited.add(child)
                    stack.append(child)
        return False
        
    improved_dag = True
    while improved_dag:
        improved_dag = False
        best_delta = 1e-5
        best_op = None
        
        for i in range(N):
            for j in range(N):
                if i == j: continue
                if dag_matrix[i, j] == 1:
                    pa_j = [p for p in range(N) if dag_matrix[p, j] == 1 and p != i]
                    s_del = get_score(j, pa_j) - get_score(j, pa_j + [i])
                    if s_del > best_delta:
                        best_delta = s_del; best_op = ('del', i, j)
                        
                    dag_matrix[i, j] = 0
                    if not has_path(i, j, dag_matrix):
                        pa_i = [p for p in range(N) if dag_matrix[p, i] == 1]
                        s_rev = (get_score(i, pa_i + [j]) + get_score(j, pa_j)) - \
                                (get_score(i, pa_i) + get_score(j, pa_j + [i]))
                        if s_rev > best_delta:
                            best_delta = s_rev; best_op = ('rev', i, j)
                    dag_matrix[i, j] = 1
                    
                elif dag_matrix[j, i] == 0:
                    if not has_path(j, i, dag_matrix):
                        pa_j = [p for p in range(N) if dag_matrix[p, j] == 1]
                        s_add = get_score(j, pa_j + [i]) - get_score(j, pa_j)
                        if s_add > best_delta:
                            best_delta = s_add; best_op = ('add', i, j)
                            
        if best_op is not None:
            op, i, j = best_op
            if op == 'add': dag_matrix[i, j] = 1
            elif op == 'del': dag_matrix[i, j] = 0
            elif op == 'rev':
                dag_matrix[i, j] = 0
                dag_matrix[j, i] = 1
            improved_dag = True

    nodes = [GraphNode(f"X{i + 1}") for i in range(N)]
    G = GeneralGraph(nodes)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            if dag_matrix[i, j] == 1:
                G.add_edge(Edge(nodes[i], nodes[j], Endpoint.TAIL, Endpoint.ARROW))
                
    return dag2cpdag(G)
# =====================================================================

import numpy as np
from causallearn.graph.GeneralGraph import GeneralGraph
import numpy as np
from causallearn.graph.GeneralGraph import GeneralGraph
from causallearn.graph.GraphNode import GraphNode

# =====================================================================
# EDITABLE: implement run_causal_discovery below
# =====================================================================
def run_causal_discovery(X: np.ndarray) -> GeneralGraph:
    """Direction-aware consensus selection over discrete causal discovery candidates."""
    from causallearn.search.ScoreBased.GES import ges
    from causallearn.search.ConstraintBased.PC import pc

    n, p = X.shape
    nodes = [GraphNode(f"X{i + 1}") for i in range(p)]
    cards = np.array([len(np.unique(X[:, i])) for i in range(p)], dtype=int)
    rs = np.random.RandomState(0)
    idx = rs.permutation(n)
    cut = max(1, n - max(64, n // 5))
    tr, va = X[idx[:cut]], X[idx[cut:]]
    if len(va) == 0:
        tr, va = X[:-1], X[-1:]

    def norm_graph(g):
        return g["G"] if isinstance(g, dict) else getattr(g, "G", g)

    def mi(a, b, ka, kb):
        c = np.bincount(a.astype(int) * kb + b.astype(int), minlength=ka * kb).reshape(ka, kb).astype(float)
        nn, pa, pb = c.sum(), c.sum(1, keepdims=True), c.sum(0, keepdims=True)
        ex = pa @ pb
        nz = c > 0
        return float((c[nz] / nn * (np.log(c[nz] * nn) - np.log(ex[nz]))).sum())

    MI = np.zeros((p, p), float)
    for i in range(p):
        for j in range(i + 1, p):
            MI[i, j] = MI[j, i] = mi(tr[:, i], tr[:, j], int(cards[i]), int(cards[j]))
    marg = [np.bincount(tr[:, i].astype(int), minlength=int(cards[i])).astype(float) for i in range(p)]
    state_cap = int(max(24, min(320, 3 * np.sqrt(len(tr)))))
    ll_cache = {}

    def masks(G):
        A = np.asarray(G.graph)
        D = (A == -1) & (A.T == 1)  # i -> j
        S = (A != 0) | (A.T != 0)
        U = S & ~D & ~D.T
        return S, D, U

    def edge_count(S):
        return int(np.count_nonzero(np.triu(S, 1)))

    def dir_count(D):
        return int(D.sum())

    def pick_cond(i, parents=(), neighbors=()):
        used, sel, prod = set(), [], 1
        for group, quota in ((parents, 3), (neighbors, 2)):
            order = sorted({int(j) for j in group if j != i and int(j) not in used}, key=lambda j: MI[i, j], reverse=True)
            taken = 0
            for j in order:
                cj = int(cards[j])
                if len(sel) >= 5:
                    break
                if prod * cj <= state_cap or not sel or (group is parents and taken < quota):
                    sel.append(j)
                    used.add(j)
                    prod *= cj
                    taken += 1
        return tuple(sorted(sel))

    def node_ll(i, cond):
        key = (int(i), tuple(sorted(int(j) for j in cond if j != i)))
        if key in ll_cache:
            return ll_cache[key]
        base = marg[i]
        if len(key[1]) == 0:
            prob = (base + 0.5) / (base.sum() + 0.5 * cards[i])
            val = float(np.log(prob[va[:, i].astype(int)]).sum() / max(1, len(va)))
        else:
            c = np.array(key[1], dtype=int)
            mult = np.cumprod(np.r_[1, cards[c[:-1]]]).astype(int)
            ktr = (tr[:, c].astype(int) * mult).sum(1)
            kva = (va[:, c].astype(int) * mult).sum(1)
            R = int(np.prod(cards[c]))
            joint = np.bincount(ktr * int(cards[i]) + tr[:, i].astype(int), minlength=R * int(cards[i])).reshape(R, int(cards[i])).astype(float)
            den = joint.sum(1)
            num = joint[kva, va[:, i].astype(int)]
            seen = den[kva] > 0
            prob = np.empty(len(va), float)
            prob[seen] = (num[seen] + 0.5) / (den[kva][seen] + 0.5 * cards[i])
            prob[~seen] = (base[va[:, i].astype(int)][~seen] + 0.5) / (base.sum() + 0.5 * cards[i])
            val = float(np.log(prob).sum() / max(1, len(va)))
        ll_cache[key] = val
        return val

    def factor_score(S, D):
        U = S & ~D & ~D.T
        total = 0.0
        for i in range(p):
            pa = np.where(D[:, i])[0]
            un = np.where(U[:, i])[0]
            total += node_ll(i, pick_cond(i, pa, un))
        bonus = 0.0
        ii, jj = np.where(D)
        for a, b in zip(ii.tolist(), jj.tolist()):
            pa_b = np.where(D[:, b])[0]
            un_b = np.where(U[:, b])[0]
            gain = node_ll(b, pick_cond(b, pa_b, un_b)) - node_ll(b, pick_cond(b, [k for k in pa_b if k != a], un_b))
            pa_a = np.where(D[:, a])[0]
            un_a = np.where(U[:, a])[0]
            rev = node_ll(a, pick_cond(a, pa_a, un_a)) - node_ll(a, pick_cond(a, [*pa_a, b], un_a))
            bonus += max(-0.02, min(0.02, gain + rev))
        return total + 0.35 * bonus - 0.015 * edge_count(S) / max(1, p)

    avg_card = float(cards.mean())
    cand_specs = [("ges", lambda: norm_graph(ges(X, score_func="local_score_BDeu")))]
    if p <= 28:
        from causallearn.search.PermutationBased.BOSS import boss
        cand_specs.append(("boss", lambda: norm_graph(boss(X, score_func="local_score_BDeu"))))
    if p <= 30:
        from causallearn.search.PermutationBased.GRaSP import grasp
        cand_specs.append(("grasp", lambda: norm_graph(grasp(X, score_func="local_score_BDeu"))))
    pc_tests = ["chisq", "gsq"] if p <= 15 else (["gsq"] if (avg_card > 2.5 or p >= 30) else ["chisq"])
    for test_name in pc_tests:
        cand_specs.append((f"pc_{test_name}", lambda t=test_name: norm_graph(pc(X, alpha=0.05, indep_test=t, stable=True, show_progress=False))))

    cands = []
    for name, fn in cand_specs:
        try:
            G = fn()
            S, D, _ = masks(G)
            pred = max(factor_score(S, D), factor_score(S, D.T))
            cands.append({"name": name, "G": G, "S": S, "D": D, "pred": pred, "e": edge_count(S), "d": dir_count(D)})
        except Exception:
            pass
    if not cands:
        try:
            return norm_graph(ges(X, score_func="local_score_BDeu"))
        except Exception:
            return GeneralGraph(nodes)

    sup = sum(c["S"].astype(float) for c in cands) / len(cands)
    dsup = sum(c["D"].astype(float) for c in cands) / len(cands)
    for c in cands:
        agr = float(sup[c["S"]].mean()) if c["e"] else 0.0
        dagr = float(dsup[c["D"]].mean()) if c["d"] else 0.0
        decis = c["d"] / max(1, c["e"])
        bias = 0.008 * decis if (p <= 30 and c["name"] in {"boss", "grasp", "ges"}) else 0.0
        c["score"] = c["pred"] + (0.035 if p <= 35 else 0.02) * agr + 0.015 * dagr + bias

    cands.sort(key=lambda c: (c["score"], c["pred"], -c["e"]), reverse=True)
    best = cands[0]
    if p <= 30:
        perms = [c for c in cands if c["name"] in {"boss", "grasp"}]
        if perms:
            alt = max(perms, key=lambda c: c["score"])
            if best["score"] - alt["score"] < 0.015 and alt["d"] >= best["d"]:
                best = alt
    return best["G"]
# =====================================================================

import numpy as np
from causallearn.graph.GeneralGraph import GeneralGraph
from causallearn.graph.GraphNode import GraphNode

# =====================================================================
# EDITABLE: implement run_causal_discovery below
# =====================================================================
def run_causal_discovery(X: np.ndarray) -> GeneralGraph:
    """
    Input:  X of shape (n_samples, n_variables), integer-encoded discrete data
    Output: estimated CPDAG as causallearn.graph.GeneralGraph.GeneralGraph
    """
    from causallearn.utils.PCUtils import SkeletonDiscovery, Meek, UCSepset
    from causallearn.utils.cit import CIT
    from causallearn.search.ScoreBased.GES import ges

    n, p = X.shape

    # Novel hybrid: reliability-adaptive PC-GES.
    # 1) Learn a conservative skeleton with alpha chosen from sample complexity.
    # 2) Learn a score-based CPDAG with GES.
    # 3) Intersect adjacencies (precision boost), then restore only highly reliable
    #    v-structures from the PC sepsets and close under Meek rules.
    # This reduces large-network false positives from GES while keeping stronger
    # orientation evidence than plain PC on small/medium regimes.
    avg_card = float(np.mean([len(np.unique(X[:, j])) for j in range(p)]))
    complexity = np.log(max(n, 2.0)) / max(avg_card, 1.0)
    if p <= 10:
        alpha = 0.10
    elif complexity > 2.2:
        alpha = 0.03
    elif complexity > 1.6:
        alpha = 0.02
    else:
        alpha = 0.01

    indep_test = CIT(X, "chisq")
    cg_pc = SkeletonDiscovery.skeleton_discovery(
        X, alpha, indep_test, stable=True,
        background_knowledge=None, verbose=False,
        show_progress=False, node_names=None,
    )
    pc_oriented = UCSepset.uc_sepset(cg_pc, 2, background_knowledge=None)
    pc_cpdag = Meek.meek(pc_oriented, background_knowledge=None).G

    ges_graph = ges(
        X,
        score_func="local_score_BDeu",
        parameters={"sample_prior": 1.0, "structure_prior": 1.0},
    )["G"]

    nodes = [GraphNode(f"X{i + 1}") for i in range(p)]
    G = GeneralGraph(nodes)

    def has_adj(graph, i, j):
        return graph.get_edge(graph.nodes[i], graph.nodes[j]) is not None

    def is_arrow(graph, i, j):
        e = graph.get_edge(graph.nodes[i], graph.nodes[j])
        if e is None:
            return False
        ep1 = str(e.get_endpoint1())
        ep2 = str(e.get_endpoint2())
        n1 = e.get_node1()
        n2 = e.get_node2()
        if n1 == graph.nodes[i] and n2 == graph.nodes[j]:
            return ep1 == "TAIL" and ep2 == "ARROW"
        if n1 == graph.nodes[j] and n2 == graph.nodes[i]:
            return ep1 == "ARROW" and ep2 == "TAIL"
        return False

    # Skeleton intersection with a small-network safeguard.
    for i in range(p):
        for j in range(i + 1, p):
            in_pc = has_adj(pc_cpdag, i, j)
            in_ges = has_adj(ges_graph, i, j)
            keep = (in_pc and in_ges) or (p <= 8 and (in_pc or in_ges))
            if keep:
                G.add_undirected_edge(nodes[i], nodes[j])

    # Orient only consensus arrows or PC v-structures to avoid over-orientation.
    for i in range(p):
        for j in range(p):
            if i == j or not has_adj(G, i, j):
                continue
            if is_arrow(ges_graph, i, j) and is_arrow(pc_cpdag, i, j):
                if has_adj(G, i, j):
                    G.remove_edge(G.get_edge(nodes[i], nodes[j]))
                    G.add_directed_edge(nodes[i], nodes[j])

    # Recover reliable PC colliders surviving the hybrid skeleton.
    for y in range(p):
        nbrs = [k for k in range(p) if k != y and has_adj(G, k, y)]
        for a_idx in range(len(nbrs)):
            x = nbrs[a_idx]
            for b_idx in range(a_idx + 1, len(nbrs)):
                z = nbrs[b_idx]
                if has_adj(G, x, z):
                    continue
                if is_arrow(pc_cpdag, x, y) and is_arrow(pc_cpdag, z, y):
                    if has_adj(G, x, y):
                        G.remove_edge(G.get_edge(nodes[x], nodes[y]))
                        G.add_directed_edge(nodes[x], nodes[y])
                    if has_adj(G, z, y):
                        G.remove_edge(G.get_edge(nodes[z], nodes[y]))
                        G.add_directed_edge(nodes[z], nodes[y])

    return Meek.meek(G, background_knowledge=None).G
# =====================================================================
# =====================================================================
